title: Estate Planning & Probate
description: Wills, trusts, probate and inheritance disputes. For families with assets in both the US and China, planning ahead saves substantial time and cost.
intro: Many Chinese families encounter probate for the first time when a parent dies, and only then discover that without a will the house is frozen for months or longer. The second recurring problem is cross-border inheritance: property and accounts in China, and a US process that doesn't reach them. We help you set the arrangements up in advance, or get the process through afterwards. (This is general information about how such matters usually proceed, not advice on your specific case. Where representation is needed, a licensed attorney at a partner law firm handles it.)
